integrity: The claim is proved symbolically. The finite verifier is regression evidence only and is not used to infer the infinite theorem. Source dates and MSC ownership are taken from the journal records.
limitations: The theorem treats only bases of the form \(n=2^A p\) with odd-prime exponent one. It does not classify higher odd-prime exponents, more prime supports, or other arithmetic functions. A 2024 monograph in the same research program was not available in full text and remains a literature risk.
title: Complete divisor-sum fiber for two-prime Set objects
